title: Tech App Day Flow Deck
brands: Smart Upkeep brand: white or warm cream base, terracotta, lagoon and jungle pops (tech app = lagoon), Khand and Hind, light mode only, 44px tap targets. Header = the tech's own profile; house photos only on job cards.
request: Max Oct 17 2026 ICT: UpKeep reviews and remakes the whole Smart Upkeep technician app (tech/?dash=1-3); Branding gives design input and a deck on the layout choices still open.
not_reasked: Home History on the job card
member header system (white + accent, logo centered, no greeting, quick action tiles, shrinks and sticks)
example_data: Marco Example, 123 Sample Lane and all addresses, times and counts are placeholders.

pairs.ask: Tech App Today: Profile header, should the tech's headshot sit left of the name or centered above it?

optionA.label: Headshot Left Of Name
optionA.desc: Compact row, more of the day shows
